text.en:
Upon Reload within 6 seconds of a Weapon Kill:
20 Aim Assist, -20% Accuracy Cone Size, and [+?] Handling (ADS only) for 5 seconds.

Can be refreshed.

enhanced (
#e Buff Duration is increased.
)
text.zh-chs:
消灭目标后在 6 秒内填装：
+20 瞄准辅助、-20% 瞄准圆锥范围、[?] 瞄准时的操控性，持续 5 秒。

该增益持续时间无法被刷新。

enhanced (
#e 增加增益持续时间。
)
